description: Unmodified synthetic benchmark/probe receipts exported from the October22 four-GB10 GLM study. Source bytes and relative paths are preserved. No current deployment claim is made by export.
excluded_categories: Gateway configuration and operational control helpers.
Weight and image transfers; no model weights, binaries or tokens are included.
preservation_note: Legacy producer paths and nonsecret hardware/localhost settings remain in raw receipts so their original hash chains can be checked. Export does not rewrite invalid captures, confounded trials or source reports.
